name: Black Dog: Novella
source:
Bound by a mask you cannot remove, you wander caverns that breathe like a living thing. Screaming faces are carved into stone, prisoners rot with hollow eyes, and a gaping maw draws you closer. 

Every choice leaves a scar, hardening or breaking your resolve. Will you step forward – or fall?

[From [url=https://blackdognovella.itch.io/bdnp]Itch.io[/url]]
